name: zendesk-mcp
description: Zendesk (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, send, reply. Every tool maps to a documented endp

platform_mcp_zendesk_email_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZENDESK_EMAIL_TOKEN
platform_mcp_zendesk_email_token.description: Agent email followed by /token, e.g. jdoe@example.com/token: API-token auth is Basic '{email_address}/token:{api_token}' (https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/introduction/security-and-auth/).

platform_mcp_zendesk_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZENDESK_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_zendesk_api_token.description: API token from Admin Center > Apps and integrations > APIs > Zendesk API.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Show Self: account.user is the authenticated agent (an anonymous user without id means the credentials were not accepted).

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: Tickets (one row per ticket, most recently updated first; offset pagination, max 100 per page). text is the ticket description (first comment); thread_id is the ticket id for get_thread / reply. `since` is not sent.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Comments of ticket `thread_id`, oldest first (public replies and internal notes; raw.public tells them apart).

tools.name: send
tools.description: Creates a ticket with requester `to` (email; Zendesk creates the user if unknown) and `text` as the first comment, which notifies the requester per the account's triggers. message_id is the ticket id.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Adds a PUBLIC comment to ticket `thread_id` (Update Ticket with ticket.comment); message_id is the id of the audit the update produced.
